info.title: The Outbound Package API for the Geoprise GM-X Auto Enterprise Resources Planning (ERP) Application
info.description: The Outbound Package API provides distinct groupings of goods, such as boxes, crates, or pallets, that are wrapped, contained, and tracked together as part of outbound shipments.

choose.description: instruction to return any selection (or multiple selections, if allowed) to previous form

choosenull.description: instruction to return no selections to previous form

clear.description: instruction to remove all search criteria

collapse.description: instruction to hide all the branches and leaves of the tree

copy.description: instruction to copy the values of all form fields for pasting into a different instance of the same form

created_date.description: the date and time on which the record was created

created_user.description: the identity of the user which created the record

csrf_id.description: unique request verification value for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection

delete.description: instruction to delete the record in the current form from the database

error.description: error encountered during validation of data submitted for a specific form field (if any)

errmsg.description: error encountered during validation or processing of entire form (if any)

expand.description: instruction to show all the branches and leaves of the tree

infomsg.description: short description of successful processing outcome
infomsg.example: The payment amount matches the document balances - payment is complete

InnerData.description: A one-indexed collection of data for inner zone of the form. Keys begin with the column name, followed by a row number suffix enclosed in square braces ("[" and "]") which must be string representations of positive integers starting at "1". $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/numrows and $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/lastpage define the maximum row number from the following formula: maximum = IF (numrows / lastpage > 50 then 100 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 25 then 50 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 10 then 25 ELSE 10)))

InnerDataNoLimit.description: A one-indexed collection of data for inner zone of the form. Keys begin with the column name, followed by a row number suffix enclosed in square braces ("[" and "]") which must be string representations of positive integers starting at "1".

InnerTasks.description: A one-indexed collection of popup tasks for inner zone of the form. Keys begin with the task ID (prefixed by "#task#inner#"), followed by a row number suffix enclosed in square braces ("[" and "]") which must be string representations of positive integers starting at "1". $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/numrows and $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/lastpage define the maximum row number from the following formula: maximum = IF (numrows / lastpage > 50 then 100 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 25 then 50 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 10 then 25 ELSE 10)))

lastitem.description: total number of rows returned by the query

LoggedInAs.description: user name and last GET request timestamp, for desktop display

LoggedInAsName.description: user name without last GET request timestamp, for mobile display

active.description: indicates if the menu button can currently be used to send a GET request to the GM-X server
indicates if the breadcrumb link can currently be used to send a GET request to the GM-X server

id.description: 'task#', followed by zone ID, followed by '#', followed by task ID

context_preselect.description: indicates if an item must be selected from the list (Y) before activating the button, or not (N)

OuterData.description: A one-indexed collection of data for outer zone of the form. Keys prefixed by "__outer__", followed by the column name

example.__outer__journal_desc: Subsidiary expenses paid by corporate parent

numrows.description: total number of rows returned by the query

curpage.description: total number of rows returned by the query

lastpage.description: total number of pages returned by the query (at maximum of 10, 25, 50, or 100 rows per page)

PaginationWidth.description: defines how the pagination area is displayed; default display if zero, Google style display otherwise

paste.description: instruction to paste the values of all form fields copied from a different instance of the same form; required when values of form fields have been copied from a different instance

ProjectCode.description: customisation project code for this server instance

quicksearch.description: instruction to query the records using the quicksearch criterion, and then re-display current form

quitCancel.description: instruction to return to previous form

quitClose.description: instruction to return to previous form

rdc_selection_lock.description: instruction to lock selected record(s) to re-select them automatically when returning to current form

reset.description: instruction to remove all search criteria, sorting, and page settings, and then re-display current form

revised_date.description: the date and time on which the record was last updated

revised_user.description: the identity of the user which last updated the record

ScriptURL.description: concatenation of URL followed by path

ScrollingWidth.description: defines how the scrolling area is displayed; default display if zero, Google style display otherwise

select.description: A sparse, one-indexed collection indicating selected rows on the form. Keys do not need to be sequential but must be string representations of positive integers starting at "1". $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/numrows and $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/lastpage define the maximum collection size from the following formula: maximum = IF (numrows / lastpage > 50 then 100 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 25 then 50 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 10 then 25 ELSE 10)))

selectNoLimit.description: A sparse, one-indexed collection indicating selected rows on the form. Keys do not need to be sequential but must be string representations of positive integers starting at "1".

selectOne.description: Indicates the row selected from a popup form that allows only one row to be selected. The selected row number must be a string representation of a positive integer starting at "1". $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/numrows and $ref: #/components/schema/Page/properties/lastpage define the maximum allowable value from the following formula: maximum = IF (numrows / lastpage > 50 then 100 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 25 then 50 ELSE IF (numrows / lastpage > 10 then 25 ELSE 10)))

session_name.description: Name of session cookie set by GM-X application server after successful Internal, RADIUS, LDAP, or SSL authentication.

submitBtn.description: instruction to process the form and then return to previous form if successful, or re-display current form with error message(s) if unsuccessful

submitnext.description: instruction to process the form and then scroll to next form (or return to previous form if current form is the last in scrolling sequence) if successful, or re-display current form with error message(s) if unsuccessful

submitstay.description: instruction to process the form and then display a fresh copy of this form if successful, or re-display current form with error message(s) if unsuccessful

action.name: action
action.description: instruction to log off, create a new session, or select/unselect all rows of the current page returned by the query (at maximum of 10, 25, 50, or 100 rows per page)

collapsed.name: collapsed
collapsed.description: unique identity of a specific tree view node to be collapsed so its branches and leaves are hidden

csrf_id.name: csrf_id
csrf_id.description: unique request verification value for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection; required for GET requests using different path

expand.name: expand
expand.description: unique identity of a specific tree view node to be expanded so its branches and leaves are visible

item.name: item
item.description: instruction to return a specific row returned by a query; required when scrolling parameter exists

page.name: page
page.description: instruction to return a specific page of the rows returned by a query; required when pagination parameter exists

pagesize.name: pagesize
pagesize.description: instruction to return a maximum of 10, 25, 50, or 100 rows per page

pagination.name: pagination
pagination.description: applicable zone for a pagination request (e.g. main, outer, inner, middle, middle1, middle2, link); required when page parameter exists

scrolling.name: scrolling
scrolling.description: applicable class for a scrolling request; required when scrolling parameter exists

selection.name: selection
selection.description: task ID selection from menu bar

session_name.name: session_name
session_name.description: Name of session cookie set by GM-X application server after successful Internal, RADIUS, LDAP, or SSL authentication.

taskid.name: taskid
taskid.description: task associated with request; required when accessing written help

AWSELBAuth.name: AWSELBAuthSessionCookie-0
AWSELBAuth.description: The AWS ALB authentication session cookie. If its size is greater than 4K, and less than 11K, the load balancer shards it into multiple cookies (AWSELBAuthSessionCookie-0, AWSELBAuthSessionCookie-1, etc.).

sessionAuth.description: The PHP session cookie set by GM-X application server after successful Internal, RADIUS, LDAP, or SSL authentication.
